title: Physicist Objection Closure Map

canonical_node.axiom: The strongest public claim is that Lean proves which structural claims are allowed, and Python/Colab shows how those claims behave under computation, simulation, symbolic derivation, or page-level verification.
definitions: Lean layer: formal proofs of structural gates, invariants, and collapse conditions.
Python/Colab layer: runtime notebooks and scripts demonstrating dynamics, coupling, and numerical/symbolic checks.
Evidence ledger: a canonical mapping from each objection to its proof artifact and runtime artifact.
Coupling invariant: a preserved structural property under transformation, as in quaternion vs vector-only product.
Malformed triad: a three-part system that fails role profile, coupling, or invariant conditions.
derivation: The document asserts that Lean proofs alone are insufficient; the stronger claim couples Lean structural proofs with Python/Colab behavioral demonstrations.
It identifies current artifacts for Lean audit, source index, Colab mirrors, verification packages, and page audits.
It enumerates coupling break points where malformed triads fail, establishing that not all three-part systems are valid.
It provides a closure ledger mapping twelve objections to Lean and Python/Colab answers, with statuses and next repairs.
It recommends topbar/manifest fields to expose objection closure status and publication gates.
canonical_node.action: Create a canonical evidence ledger that routes each objection to its proof artifact and runtime artifact, and wire it into the site's topbar/manifest so every page can show proof, runtime, and open-gate status.
boundary: Does not claim that all objections are fully closed; several are open or gated.
Does not claim that Lean proofs alone establish physical truth; they establish structural claims.
Does not claim that n=3 is the only possible architecture unless uniqueness is proven.
Does not claim that the consciousness leg is fully closed; it is publication gated.
Does not claim that Heaviside is invalid as engineering; it claims a lost coupling invariant.
test: Check that each objection in the closure ledger has a corresponding Lean theorem or explicit statement of absence.
Check that each objection has a Python/Colab artifact or explicit statement of absence.
Check that the topbar/manifest fields reflect the statuses in the closure ledger.
Check that the publication rule is followed: do not say 'no escape hatch' until the ledger is wired.
Check that the immediate build order items are completed before promoting the five-instance convergence page.

dg1_dependencies: Lean 4 proof files and audit summaries
Page quality audit and equation registry
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a canonical mapping from objections to proof and runtime artifacts, enabling transparent routing of objections and exposing open gates.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing Lean proofs and Python/Colab artifacts as the evidence spine, without altering their content.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this map, objections cannot be systematically routed to evidence, and the public claim of closure cannot be substantiated.

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as a coordination map; do not treat as proof of physical claims

overstatement_risks: Claiming that all objections are closed when several are open or gated.
Claiming that Lean proofs alone establish physical truth.
Claiming that n=3 is the only possible architecture without uniqueness proof.
Claiming that the consciousness leg is fully closed when it is publication gated.
kill_conditions: If the evidence ledger is not wired into the site, the map loses its purpose.
If the open items (stability sweep, provenance, consciousness holes) are not addressed, the map overstates closure.
If the publication rule is violated, the map's integrity is compromised.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the coupling invariant and collapse conditions for malformed triads, and prove minimal sufficiency of n=3 if intended.

plain_summary: This document is a coordination map that pairs each physicist objection with Lean proof artifacts and Python/Colab runtime artifacts, aiming to create a transparent evidence ledger. It identifies open items and publication gates, and recommends wiring the ledger into the site's manifest. It does not itself prove any physical claim; it is a methodological guide.
